cz-regional.document.metadata: the object holding the thirteen metadata keys below, each of which carries its own disposition
cz-regional.document.tableCellInfo: a paragraph's placement inside a table; every payload sampled states it as null, so the shape a non-null value would take is unstated and nothing can be read from it
cz-regional.document.styles[].alignment: how the paragraph was aligned on the printed page; the document model carries the text and its emphasis, not its layout
cz-regional.document.styles[].hasSpaceBefore: vertical spacing above the paragraph on the printed page, which the document model does not represent
cz-regional.document.styles[].hasSpaceAfter: vertical spacing below the paragraph on the printed page, which the document model does not represent

cz-ns.Senátní značka: The same docket under the label this court prints for its insolvency senate register. The row's docket is the one the listing entry states, which is what the document was fetched by.
